children.approach: C5 (from the attached PDF's title/abstract, since the email states only that C5 'fell to five lines of combinatorics'): for the level-1 Uglov q-Fock space F_e of U_q(sl-hat_e), e >= 2, with P_e the ribbon-sign operator and v_{k',e} := P_e^{k'}|∅⟩, the Kashiwara-crystal string has length at most one — eps_i(v_{k',e}) <= 1 for all i in Z/eZ and all k' >= 1.
